$comment: F5.1 — the only place a skipped test is permitted, and only with an owner and a death date.
Read by scripts/check-test-skips.mjs. Every entry needs test, reason, owner and expires.
An expired entry fails the build exactly as an unauthorized skip does: the exemption has to be
renewed deliberately or the test has to start running again. A trailing '*' matches a prefix.
Dependency-backed tests run with VNI_REQUIRE_MONGO=1 and VNI_REQUIRE_MINIO=1 in CI, so missing
infrastructure is never exempt. One entry covers the valid one-in-a-million equality case
where a replacement-code test has no two distinct values to compare. The content-integrity
entry covers material deliberately excluded from clean checkout until redistribution rights exist.

allow.reason: The test deliberately cannot compare replacement semantics when two independently generated six-digit codes collide; the collision itself is valid production behaviour with a one-in-a-million probability.

Exam1 is intentionally gitignored because learner redistribution rights are not established, so a clean CI checkout cannot execute this real-content integrity check; synthetic committed fixtures remain mandatory and executable.
